description: This file defines classes and interfaces for a Text-to-Speech (TTS) system, including configuration management, speech data handling, and a speaker class that manages speech synthesis using GStreamer. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to TTS functionality.

classes.name: TTSConfiguration
classes.description: Manages TTS settings such as endpoint, language, voice, volume, and rate.

classes.name: TTSSpeakerClient
classes.description: Interface for callback methods related to speech events.

classes.name: SpeechData
classes.description: Holds information about a speech request, including client, ID, text, and security flag.

classes.name: TTSSpeaker
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing speech synthesis, including pipeline control and speech queue.

methods.name: setEndPoint
methods.description: Sets the endpoint URL for TTS service.

methods.name: setSecureEndPoint
methods.description: Sets the secure endpoint URL for TTS service.

methods.name: isPreemptive
methods.description: Returns whether preemptive speaking is enabled.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is valid.

methods.name: SpeechData
methods.description: Data structure for speech request details.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker
methods.description: Handles speech synthesis, pipeline management, and speech queue.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Initiates speech synthesis for given text.

methods.name: isSpeaking
methods.description: Checks if a speech ID is currently speaking.

methods.name: getSpeechState
methods.description: Returns the current state of speech for a given ID.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses speech for a given ID.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes paused speech for a given ID.
